movingBand.observation: Not blind: historical moving media already exist. From2500 to3000, the middle-right branching group spreads into a broader lower-right cluster; the large upper-right group loses its lower-left branches and leaves a wider gap below it. These are changes in occupied shapes, not just colors or the food outline.

stationaryBand.observation: From2500 to3000, the tall upper-middle chain breaks up and a broad cluster appears along the upper-left edge. The dense middle-left/lower-middle group clears into separated small groups, while a new branching cluster occupies the lower-middle-right.

sameAgeComparisons.observation: At1500 moving has a central vertical chain and broad middle branches; stationary groups sit mainly along the left side with a large empty right half.
At2500 moving clusters occupy the right half; stationary has a tall upper-middle chain and a dense lower-middle-left group.

At3000 moving has broad lower-right branching clusters; stationary has fragmented left-side groups and one lower-middle-right branching group. These differences are descriptive, not an advantage test.
